followup.rootCause: Global receipt netting hid money not allocated to the staff-authorized quote. The session account and report could understate outstanding/refund due, while resolve checked provider gross and the incorrect global refund balance.
rules: Only active net allocations reduce charge dues; never automatically spend excess outside the original quote.
Each source refunds only its unallocated net retained funds, minus other open document reservations, checked on creation, approval and actual completion.
Only SUCCEEDED actual refund transactions reduce the owed-back balance; approval, failed refund or notes do not.
Reconciliation requires each source net receipt to equal active allocations and the verified provider gross to match the ledger.
Canceled/expired quotes received too late may resolve CANCELLED after actual returns, without false PAID/request completion.
Replays preserve reconciled cases without adding/reallocating funds; new references still require handling.
Reconciliation reports filter and total outstanding/refund obligations independently, including net-zero unresolved sessions.
